scope: Original M1 low-cost independent SAM-grid candidate <=64 fixed Val images; bounded physical comparison, not full-Val, primary qualification, M9 or semantic contribution
candidate: Frozen MASA checkpoint SAM no-crop default grid masks -> anonymous boxes -> unchanged past-only MASA tracker; separate from RPN/ROI native
selection: First four ascending Val video IDs; first at most16 image metadata rows by frame_index/image_id, no category/annotation inspection or substitution
comparison: Sealed RPN/ROI64-frame NPZ plus existing frozen PANDAS projected64-frame NPZ; no baseline inference repeat. Exact legacy metrics reproduced before new comparison accepted.
sampling_boundary: Native state resets at first selected annotated frame, annotated-only ordinal cadence. Frozen PANDAS projection keeps dense-frame association/prehistory; shared scoring frames, not a matched-input association ablation.
provenance_boundary: Published generic-image route supported; exact released SAM-B training stage config/data ledger missing. Diagnostic is not supervision certification.
quality_contract: Inherited AMG raw predicted IoU for mask filter/NMS ranking only; [0,1] mask stability for tracker/native quality, NOT foreground probability. No clamp/sigmoid/threshold/grid/crop/cap change.

evaluation.coverage: Fixed class-free temporal-IoU>=0.5 Hungarian on entire selected-clip Known/Novel GT universe; all predictions retained
evaluation.hota: Existing pinned TAO_OW adapter SUBSET=all/MAX_DETECTIONS=300, unchanged preprocessing; identical clipped GT for both streams
evaluation.lengths: Native annotated-cadence lengths and PANDAS annotated projection lengths only; not full-video lifetime lengths
evaluation.purity: Per-frame geometric match first; categories/identity mixing aggregate only after prediction sealing. Unknown unmatched rows not declared background/pure.

stop_rules: No sample substitution/extension to acquire Novel targets
All predictions including empty frames must seal before evaluator-only GT; no geometric filtering/rescue after GT
Preserve failed/partial runs; no automatic rerun, cap or prompt microbatch change
No full-Val/cache or primary freeze from this bounded diagnostic
No R2, policy exception expansion, semantic training/tuning, M11 or Test
publish: Aggregate physical metrics/counts/coverage/pollution/lengths/hashes/resources only; raw NPZ and clipped GT stay private; small-sample zeroNovel2 cannot establish full-Val quality
